title: /loop vs /schedule in Claude Code — When to Use Each
description:
Not the same command. /loop is for short tasks — minutes to an hour. Check in every 5 or 10 minutes while something runs. /schedule is for long-term automation — daily, weekly, monthly. Set it once and it runs on its own. Example: use /loop to track a big download. Use /schedule to pull daily leads and send them to a follow-up agent. Know the difference. Follow for more Claude Code tips.
